description: Soft-delete a single SeoScoredKeyword (sets deletedAt; the row stays in the DB but is filtered out of all queries). Housekeeping op — not part of the main flow. Pass `confirm: true` to proceed. Use for obvious junk keywords the auto-pipeline missed. Prefer seo_edit_keyword with excludedFromClustering=true when you only want to hold a keyword out of the next clustering pass.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm soft-delete

name: seo_delete_keyword
